description:
One-call summary of a property: what it is, what building it belongs to,
    and the headline attributes. Once you have the UPRN this is the first call
    to make for a specific property — it usually answers the question on its
    own, and `property_report` composes the rest.
    UK only. Costs 20 credits (20p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_summary
title: Property summary
